# Executed: Vantorre enterprise MSA

**From:** June Osei-Lark <joseilark@pemberline.com>  
**To:** Ruth Calloway <rcalloway@pemberline.com>, Anselm Grieve <agrieve@pemberline.com>, Nadia Fennimore <nfennimore@pemberline.com>, Gideon Sato <gsato@pemberline.com>  
**Date:** 6/30/25, 4:48 PM  
**Subject:** Executed: Vantorre enterprise MSA  

All—

Finally across the line. The Vantorre enterprise MSA was signed today, 6/30/25, effective 7/1/25. Covers both Vantorre Group and Vantorre Mobility under the single paper. 

Fully countersigned PDF is uploading to the deal room folder now (slow wifi on the train, give it 5 mins). 

Couple quick operational notes from the final call w/ Mateo Quiroga:
- VTG's Allentown yard wants their instance spun up before the holiday weekend rush. Specifically bays 14 through 22 on the East Apron where the flatbed steel coils come in. 
- VMob's Newark depot has that weird shift change at 2:30 PM where the yard jockeys swap tablets—still throwing error code `DOCK-409` in staging when driver check-in overlaps. Ticket #88412 is in the queue for eng.
- Mateo asked for the clean CSV export template for the `Carrier_Turn_Time_v3` report. Said his dock supervisors at VTRG are still tracking gate wait times on clipboards after 6 PM.

I'm heading offline in ten, catching the 5:15. Will update the tracker tomorrow morning. Please make sure provisioning sees the 7/1/25 effective date so we don't lock out the Newark gatehouse kiosk at midnight.

—JOL

***

**---------- Forwarded message ---------**  
**From:** Mateo Quiroga <mquiroga@vantorre.com>  
**Date:** 6/30/25, 4:39 PM  
**Subject:** RE: Pemberline Systems / Vantorre — Final MSA for signature  
**To:** June Osei-Lark <joseilark@pemberline.com>  

June,

Envelope is completed on our end. You should have the DocuSign confirmation in your inbox now. Good to have Vantorre Group and Vantorre Mobility under one roof with Pemberline Dock starting 7/1/25. 

One practical thing—can someone send over the hardware spec sheet for the ruggedized Zebra scanners? Our receiving lead in Allentown, Marcus Vance, dropped two units off Dock Door 18 yesterday morning and we're ordering replacements tonight. Need to make sure the new firmware plays nice with the Pemberline Dock mobile browser before third shift starts Sunday night.

Thanks for pushing legal through the redlines on Exhibit B this afternoon. 

Regards,

**Mateo Quiroga**  
Head of Procurement  
Vantorre Group
